approval: owner pre-approval 2026-10-19 (verbatim in APPROVAL_RECORD_CTT.json) + the sealed zip sha256; cap 8.00 USD; one attempt + one plumbing retry
cost_cap_status: OWNER PRE-APPROVED 8 USD (line quoted in APPROVAL_RECORD_CTT.json)

attempts.plumbing_retry_rule: only if no model was scored (the run stopped in refusals, preflight, data build or training because of plumbing); same zip, same exam carrier, same settings; any package change is a reseal and needs a new owner word
attempts.anti_tuning: no rerun with a different learning rate, size, schedule or seed to coax a pass; a miss is a result

host.instance: g5.xlarge (1 x NVIDIA A10G 24 GB, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB RAM)
host.fallback_instance: g4dn.xlarge (1 x NVIDIA T4 16 GB) only if g5 capacity is refused; training is then about 3 times slower and may hit the wall cap (then INSTRUMENT_ERROR, never a pass)

price_usd_per_hour_on_demand.note: list prices; the controller checks the price page on the day

host.image: an AWS Deep Learning AMI with PyTorch 2.x and CUDA (python3 with torch importable in the system interpreter); no other model files
host.self_terminate: shutdown -h +360 set at boot, instance-initiated shutdown behaviour = terminate

deadlines.runner_deadline: kit/run_ctt.py stops every stage at min(--deadline-epoch, start + 5 h)

estimate.preflight_minutes: about 8-15 (unit tests about 1, smoke build about 1, 50-step smoke train about 2, translator audit about 1)
estimate.training_minutes: about 70-110 on g5 for A4 x 3 + C1 (each about 12,000 steps of 256 pairs) + A5; C2 is init only
estimate.noharm_minutes: about 5 (laptop OFF run of one 64-item exam: 3.8 s)
estimate.expected_usd: about 2-3.5 on g5 including boot and cleanup
estimate.worst_case_usd: 8.00 (the controller stops at the cap across both attempts)

stages_in_order: NO-HARM off with the translator folder deleted
record_per_job: source: this zip sha256 and PACKAGE_FREEZE sha256
actual cost from the billing record
cleanup: instance terminated and volumes deleted, checked by a second describe-instances / describe-volumes call; S3 leftovers deleted; temporary role/profile removed
backup: deliverable to D:/tksCAS-archive/ with three sha256 confirmations
laptop: no torch on the laptop (torch alone measured at 475 MiB RAM, above the 300 MiB per-process limit; free RAM about 754 MB, below the design's 2 GB smoke floor): the GPU smoke is stage 1 of this job, inside the cap
amendment_A_CTT_1: the primary run scores the machine-side exam E-MACHINE-S; the human exam is an optional later scoring-only job (kit/run_ctt_human.py, one GPU host, about 15-30 minutes, expected well under 1 USD) against the same frozen weights, inside the same 8.00 USD cap; it trains nothing
